verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents registrable outbound webhooks. A Create a Webhook API lets you subscribe to event types such as WORKFLOW_COMPLETED, with updates sent to your configured URL. Dedicated webhook endpoints let you set up, view and change webhook status, and deliveries carry a stable idempotency identifier that stays the same across retries. Missing for 10: a full catalog of subscribable event types beyond WORKFLOW_COMPLETED, documentation of payload signing/verification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
